modules.name: Journeys
modules.summary: What has to become true for a user, step by step, and where every piece of it stands.

modules.name: References
modules.summary: Every issue, merge request and pull request in this project, from GitHub and GitLab, as one list.

modules.name: Checklist
modules.summary: Checklists somebody wrote, held against the issues, changes, paper files and sections they were assigned to.

modules.name: Atlas
modules.summary: A map of the territory: which projects exist, and which epics are in each of them.

modules.name: Paper
modules.summary: The paper this epic is aimed at, read as prose: sections, figures and tables rather than markup.

modules.name: Slides
modules.summary: Presentation decks for a paper: Markdown slides that follow the paper as you read and present.

modules.name: Citations
modules.summary: The academic references a document cites: every entry in its .bib, and which of them the prose names.

modules.name: Notes
modules.summary: Notes anchored to a place in a document, narrowing as the reader narrows.

modules.name: Learning
modules.summary: Multiple-choice questions anchored to passages of a paper, and what a reader answered.

modules.name: Source
modules.summary: The file the canvas is pointed at, with the range a passage carries highlighted. It reads and never writes.

modules.name: Diff
modules.summary: The diff of whichever change is selected on the canvas, file by file.

modules.name: Review
modules.summary: Comment on exact lines of a change, commit by commit, and send it as one review with a verdict.

modules.name: Explorer
modules.summary: The working tree of the open project, read one directory at a time. Pressing a file points the canvas at it.

modules.name: Terminal
modules.summary: A real terminal on this machine. Your shell, in a container, with nothing else in it.

modules.name: Tests
modules.summary: How this project is tested, and what was actually run against the change you are looking at.

modules.name: History
modules.summary: A project's git history: what is committed and what is not, with commit and discard by file.

modules.name: Orchestrator
modules.summary: Start a session on what you picked, and watch what it says.

modules.name: Notifications
modules.summary: What every module on this machine has said happened, newest first, with who said it.
